summary: Pharvaris N.V. filed a Form 6-K on June 11, 2026, announcing its annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for June 26, 2026, and furnishing related materials including a press release, convening notice, agenda, explanatory notes, voting proxy, and the 2025 annual report. This is a routine corporate governance notification by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation event. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. The filing serves to meet SEC disclosure requirements for the AGM and includes standard annual report information. There is no deal, restructuring, or strategic action to analyze; this is purely a logistical meeting notice.
